name: rate-your-flow-launch-video
description: Rendered launch asset for Rate Your Flow

scripts.render: remotion render RateYourFlowX out/rate-your-flow-x.render.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p && ffmpeg -y -i out/rate-your-flow-x.render.mp4 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -movflags +faststart out/rate-your-flow-x.mp4 && rm out/rate-your-flow-x.render.mp4
